title: EPA 2027 Emissions Standards
description: What the new heavy-duty emissions rules mean for fleets buying trucks in the next model year.
body:
The EPA’s 2027 heavy-duty rules tighten NOx limits and extend useful-life and warranty requirements across Class 6–8. For fleets planning a replacement cycle, the practical question is whether to buy ahead of the change or wait for the first compliant model year.

Talk to our sales team about how the timing affects spec, lead time and residual value on the units you are considering.
